review.note: A7: the item gives no P582. "Cuanza River Campaign" at revision 1370614389 - the revision cited here - has `date = May 1580 - November 1, 1582` in its infobox and says the troops "camped in Mocumbe for two years", so the end is 1582-11-01 and its own P361 then files it under angolan-wars (batch 73). Batch 75 placed it at cuanza-river by re-importing, and wrote the end, the parent and this note back by hand: a re-import knows nothing of a pass over the record it replaces (deviation 1537).

title: Cuanza River Campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Cuanza River Campaign", at revision 1370614389, opens: "The Cuanza River Campaign was a military campaign between the Kingdom of Portugal, the Kingdom of Ndongo, and the Ambundu." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q130493316, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1580 military campaign". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
